parent_owner_outcome.remaining_gap: One successful fresh PM-mediated controller cycle at the real consumer seam.

normalized_outcome: Expired controller cycles acquire a truthful fail-closed terminal state that preserves historical evidence and cannot resume, while an unnecessary per-chat capability-receipt prerequisite is removed so the already-authorized fresh PM-mediated fixture can provide direct consumer-seam evidence.

required_outcomes.observable: An expired controller WAIT cycle terminalizes only after central admission and local send ambiguity are clear, preserves its prior evidence, is idempotent, ignores late artifacts, and no longer blocks fresh-cycle admission.
The three-current-receipt gate is either removed as unnecessary requirement accretion or replaced only by the smallest lifecycle check proved necessary to prevent a material unsafe action.
No live capability probe is submitted while determining or implementing the gate repair.
The smallest focused candidate is tested, documented in plain English, opened for review, and left unmerged.

requirement_accretion.requirement: Current capability receipts for all three registered non-production chats before the fresh PM-mediated fixture.
requirement_accretion.what_breaks_if_removed: A missing or disconnected app may cause the real fixture to fail closed at its existing exact app/tool or artifact-receipt boundary; no material unsafe destination or send authority has yet been identified.
requirement_accretion.strongest_simpler_alternative: Use exact MISSION_CONTROL_ONLY registration, central single-use admission, automation-owned target/window and provider-session binding, exact visible consumer controls, exact per-message app selection, and the fixture's own server-observed MCP/GitHub receipts.

non_satisfying_proxies: Deleting or overwriting the expired cycle
Changing its prior WAIT state without recording the terminal reason and prior step
Treating a central admission as clear without a fresh authority read
Running capability probes instead of establishing gate necessity
Green helper tests without the relay admission regression
